protocol.aggregation: unweighted mean of task-level accuracy differences

randomness.seeding_point: set once immediately before the six-task run
randomness.draw_schedule: one random direction per eligible token and sample, consumed in the recorded deterministic task/sample order

matched_random_construction.real_reference: mu_k + alpha_interp * (x - mu_k), where mu_k is the nearest released text centroid
matched_random_construction.random_reference: x - u * ||x - mu_k||_2, where u is an isotropic random unit vector
matched_random_construction.matching_guarantee: For every eligible token, real and random reference displacements have exactly equal L2 norm before dtype conversion and receive the same (1-alpha_interp) scale.
matched_random_construction.difference: The directions differ: nearest-centroid residual versus an isotropic random direction.

primary_equal_norm_random_direction.claim_scope: This one-seed, one-comparator result supports sensitivity to the tested perturbation direction at equal per-token displacement norm. It does not establish that K-means geometry is uniquely necessary, identify a mechanism, or provide a randomized-control dose curve.

archival_options_only_three_controls.status: historical integrity record; not primary specificity evidence

protocol.text_span: final 30% of the post-image tail (historically labeled options)
protocol.aggregation: unweighted mean of rounded task-level accuracy differences over the three TEXT-COMPETES tasks

implementation_audit.real_tccd: The real branch uses the supplied alpha_interp=0.3.
implementation_audit.full_residual_norm_gaussian: The historical matched-noise label uses the full alpha_interp=0 nearest-centroid residual norm, ignores the supplied nominal alpha, and calls torch.randn_like without pinning the Torch RNG in this producer.
implementation_audit.fixed_random_projection: The branch projects onto a seed-42 dictionary of random unit directions scaled to the original token norm; it ignores the supplied nominal alpha.
implementation_audit.random_centroid_assignment: The branch replaces tokens with randomly selected centroids, ignores the supplied nominal alpha, and does not pass its seeded generator to torch.randint.
implementation_audit.nominal_sweep_status: The alternative-control rows at different nominal alpha values are alpha-independent constructions (with fresh unpinned draws for two branches), not dose-response curves.

usage_restrictions: Do not call the alternatives dose-matched to real TCCD.
Do not plot or interpret the alternative rows as alpha dose-response curves.
Do not use this record to claim that perturbation magnitude alone was ruled out or that K-means geometry is uniquely necessary.
